title: Variable Type Conversion
code:
i = 20
j = 20.5

print(int(j))
print(str(i))
print(hex(i))
print(oct(i))

lines.explanation: This statement assigns the integer '20' to the variable 'i'
This statement assigns the floating point value '20.5' to the variable 'j'

This statement explicitly converts the float value of variable 'j' into an integer. Since it is now an integer, it will print out '20'. This conversion is dynamic and the original value of variable 'j' is not updated
This statement explicitly converts the integer value of variable 'i' into a string. It will print out the string "20"
This statement will convert the value of 'i' into its equivalent hexadecimal value. The resultant output will be '0x14'
This statement will convert the value of 'i' into its equivalent octadecimal value. The resultant output will be '0o24'
